reference_sql:
WITH sept AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend rows in September 2025
  SELECT a.campaign_id, SUM(a.clicks) AS clicks, SUM(a.impressions) AS impressions
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
  GROUP BY a.campaign_id
)
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, ROUND(100.0 * s.clicks / s.impressions, 2) AS ctr_pct
FROM sept s
JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = s.campaign_id
WHERE 1.0 * s.clicks / s.impressions > (
  SELECT 1.0 * SUM(a.clicks) / SUM(a.impressions)
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30')
ORDER BY ctr_pct DESC, c.campaign_id

WITH sept AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend rows in September 2025
  SELECT campaign_id, SUM(clicks) AS clicks, SUM(impressions) AS impressions
  FROM ad_spend_daily
  WHERE spend_date >= DATE '2025-09-01' AND spend_date < DATE '2025-10-01'
  GROUP BY campaign_id
),
overall AS (  -- one row: the month's overall rate
  SELECT CAST(SUM(clicks) AS DOUBLE) / SUM(impressions) AS rate
  FROM sept
)
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, ROUND(100.0 * s.clicks / s.impressions, 2) AS ctr_pct
FROM sept s
JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = s.campaign_id
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE CAST(s.clicks AS DOUBLE) / s.impressions > o.rate
ORDER BY ctr_pct DESC, c.campaign_id ASC

solver.query:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT campaign_id, SUM(clicks) AS clicks, SUM(impressions) AS imps
  FROM ad_spend_daily
  WHERE spend_date >= DATE '2025-09-01' AND spend_date <= DATE '2025-09-30'
  GROUP BY campaign_id
), o AS (
  SELECT SUM(clicks)::DOUBLE / SUM(imps) AS rate FROM d
)
SELECT d.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, ROUND(100.0 * d.clicks / d.imps, 2) AS ctr_pct
FROM d JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = d.campaign_id CROSS JOIN o
WHERE d.imps > 0 AND d.clicks::DOUBLE / d.imps > o.rate
ORDER BY ctr_pct DESC, d.campaign_id ASC
